Review Date: Reviewed in the United States on July 14, 2022
Review Body: I should have ordered the digital version. The font is very light and rather small and the paper is thin enough to get distracted by the print on the back of the page showing through. Other reviews mentioned the story of a veteran rapist featured at the beginning of the book so I just skipped that part. Another edition should be done to remove that story as this is a book about trauma and it’s difficult to feel empathy for a rapist even if they are a veteran.

Review Date: Reviewed in the United States on October 18, 2018
Review Body:
I bought the hard copy, the digital copy on the Kindle, and the audiobook.
This authors explains the science behind the effects of trauma and tells the stories of other trauma victims in a way any layman can read this and understand. Thanks to this book I am able to acknowledge, recognize, and know I need help.
